answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. This is resilient because unearned rewards are capped and eventually burned, so an attacker cannot bank on a runaway Sybil campaign paying off. Consider a ferrous as the anchor of the cost.
